title: three kind lines
subtitle: a short practice for when it hurts

steps.answer: talking inward the way you'd talk to a good friend in a tough spot.

steps.text: when something hurts, there's a short practice with three parts.
one: this is hard. you name it, instead of pushing past it.
two: other people feel this too. you're not the only one.
three: what do i need right now? something small and real.

steps.prompt: the third line is the kind one. finish it for the book:
steps.template: when it's hard, i can give myself {x}
ideas: a glass of water and an early night.
a talk with someone who gets it.

steps.text: these three parts come from psychologist kristin neff's work on self-compassion: noticing it's hard, remembering others feel it too, and offering some kindness.
this is hard. other people feel this too. what do i need right now?
save the three lines somewhere easy to see, like the phone's lock screen.
